description: Delicious, foolproof Butter Garlic Toast with Herbs with aromatic spices, fresh local ingredients including Onion (Kanda / Pyaz), and complete macro tracking.

ingredients.name: Extra Virgin Olive Oil (Jaitun Ka Tel)

steps.instruction: Prep aromatics: finely dice Onion (Kanda / Pyaz), Tomato (Tamatar), and slit green chilies.
